predictions.rationale: Core handler that receives the stock-confirmed event, triggers the actual payment processing, and decides whether to publish success or failure.

Outbound integration event published when payment processing succeeds, explicitly representing the positive outcome of the feature.

Holds configuration (e.g., payment gateway keys) required by the payment processing logic; directly supports the feature.

Consumes the PaymentSucceeded event to update order status to Paid; refines the feature by completing the workflow on the Ordering side.
